drugs.name: Isoniazid
drugs.mechanism: Prodrug activated by KatG that inhibits mycolic acid synthesis.
drugs.efficacy: First-line sterilizing drug in drug-susceptible tuberculosis.
drugs.disease_evidence: Core first-line drug in standard tuberculosis regimens.

drugs.name: Rifampin
drugs.efficacy: First-line bactericidal drug that shortens tuberculosis treatment.
drugs.disease_evidence: Core first-line drug in standard tuberculosis regimens.

drugs.name: Pyrazinamide
drugs.mechanism: Prodrug converted to pyrazinoic acid, which disrupts mycobacterial membrane and metabolism.
drugs.efficacy: First-line drug that shortens treatment of drug-susceptible tuberculosis.
drugs.disease_evidence: Core first-line drug in standard tuberculosis regimens.

drugs.name: Ethambutol
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits arabinosyl transferase and cell-wall arabinogalactan synthesis.
drugs.efficacy: First-line drug used with isoniazid, rifampin, and pyrazinamide.
drugs.disease_evidence: Core first-line drug in standard tuberculosis regimens.

drugs.name: Bedaquiline
drugs.disease_evidence: ATP synthase inhibitor used in drug-resistant regimens.

drugs.name: Pretomanid
drugs.mechanism: Nitroimidazole prodrug activated by deazaflavin-dependent nitroreductase; inhibits mycolic acid synthesis.
drugs.efficacy: Used in BPaL regimens for drug-resistant tuberculosis.
drugs.disease_evidence: Component of BPaL and BPaLM regimens.

drugs.name: Linezolid
drugs.mechanism: Oxazolidinone that inhibits bacterial protein synthesis.
drugs.efficacy: Component of BPaL and other drug-resistant tuberculosis regimens.

drugs.name: Moxifloxacin
drugs.mechanism: Fluoroquinolone that inhibits bacterial DNA gyrase.
drugs.efficacy: Higher-dose moxifloxacin shortens treatment in four-month rifapentine regimens.
drugs.disease_evidence: Fluoroquinolone used in shortened and drug-resistant regimens.
